Hello,

I applied for the User Experience Designer role at mCaffeine because your team blends conversion-driven D2C execution with smooth shopping journeys across your digital channels.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design systems and digital creatives that cut turnaround time across more than 100 collateral pieces for corporate communications. Previously at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed findings directly back into user flows.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates structured problem solving for complex verification workflows, which you can review in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call to discuss how my background fits your upcoming campaign needs? I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai.

Ananya

Hello,

I saw the User Interface Designer opening at Morris Matrix and was drawn to your focus on building intuitive digital experiences for web applications and digital products.

During my time as a UI/UX Designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing, built wireframes, and designed interactive prototypes while collaborating directly with developers on handoff. At Ascent Business Solutions, I also produced over 100 digital assets and built reusable templates that cut turnaround time.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates my work on a cleaner verification experience for teams, which you can view in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Hyderabad. Would you have fifteen minutes next week to discuss the role?

Ananya
